theme_fields.name: yaml
theme_fields.value:
links:
  type: objects
  default:
    - name: Home
      url: /latest
  schema:
    name: link
    identifier: name
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
        required: true
        validations:
          max_length: 20
      url:
        type: string
        validations:
          url: true
      icon:
        type: icon
      image:
        type: upload
      category_ids:
        type: categories
        validations:
          max: 2
      tags:
        type: tags
      weight:
        type: integer
        validations:
          min: 1
          max: 10
      kind:
        type: enum
        choices: [a, b]
      when:
        type: datetime
      topic:
        type: topic
      flag:
        type: boolean
      children:
        type: objects
        schema:
          name: child
          properties:
            label:
              type: string
              required: true
            groups:
              type: groups
              disallowed_groups: "1"
nav_items:
  type: list
  default: "a|b"
  list_type: simple
visible_groups:
  type: list
  list_type: group
  default: "0|1"
  disallowed_groups: "2"
  resolve_group_membership: true
logo:
  type: upload
  default: hero
star:
  type: icon
  default: star
config_json:
  type: string
  default: "{}"
  json_schema: '{"type": "object"}'
count:
  type: integer
  default: 5
  max: 10
ratio:
  type: float
  default: 1

theme_fields.name: en
theme_fields.value:
en:
  theme_metadata:
    settings:
      links:
        description: The links
        schema:
          properties:
            name:
              label: Name
              description: The link's name
            children:
              schema:
                properties:
                  label:
                    label: Child label
